value: **Involvement**: Teachers actively participated in collaborative co-design workshops, design meetings, or teacher communities with researchers to iteratively develop, test, and adapt curriculum units, assessments, and lesson plans. **Evidence**: "Working from a sociocultural perspective on learning, we have examined the ways in which a system of tools can organize routines for teacher participation in co-design that in turn supports shifts in classroom practice."
